name: Yeti

growth_edges: hides a wobbling plan for one beat too long
confuses independence with doing everything alone
personality.under_stress: Talks faster, adds unnecessary steps, and physically tries to hold the plan together.
personality.growth_direction: Notice other people's needs, ask for help sooner, and take honest responsibility without becoming timid.

visual.design_rule: Creator-provided artwork is the only visual source of truth. Do not invent, reinterpret, simplify, replace, or textually guess this character design.
visual.feet: Use the exact bare feet shown in approved creator artwork; do not infer shape, color, markings, toe count, or anatomy.
visual.footwear_rule: Always barefoot. Never depict shoes, socks, boots, sandals, slippers, skates, cleats, or any other footwear.

performance.voice: Buoyant and sincere; quick when excited, quiet and unguarded when feelings become real.
performance.movement: Leads with his whole torso, starts before a sentence ends, needs three tiny recovery steps to stop.
performance.comic_behavior: Overcommits to holding, catching, or operating several things at once.
dialogue_rules: does not speak in polished moral statements
admits mistakes plainly after the emotional turn

relationships.relationship: younger brother; wants her respect and trusts her even while resisting advice
son; secure, affectionate, and expected to repair mistakes honestly
best friend and co-inventor; each is allowed to disagree
student; responds to her curious questions

continuity_locks: Creator-provided artwork is authoritative and must never be redesigned, reinterpreted, replaced, or simplified.
Yeti's mistake must grow from eagerness, imagination, or an understandable feeling—not selfish cruelty.
He remains kind even when embarrassed.
He is never made competent by losing his awkwardness.
